## Stack

`example/` is a Flutter app, so resolve it with `flutter pub get`; the package itself is pure Dart.

## Commands

| Command | When |
|---|---|
| `dart test --timeout=30s --reporter=failures-only < /dev/null` | All tests. The redirect and reporter are not optional outside a TTY: the default reporter redraws a terminal and the `prompt` suite reads stdin. |
| `dart test --tags=integration` | Integration tests (minutes, needs network). CI excludes them; run them before tagging a release. |
| `dart test --coverage=coverage && dart pub global run coverage:format_coverage --lcov --in=coverage --out=coverage/lcov.info --packages=.dart_tool/package_config.json --report-on=lib` | Coverage; CI fails below the 80% line floor. Without `--report-on=lib` the report counts dependencies and tests and reads about 48%, which looks like a regression. |
| `dart format lib/ test/ bin/ example/lib/main.dart` | Format; no diff allowed. The rest of `example/` is generated or Flutter scaffold and stays out. |
| `dart analyze lib/ test/ bin/` | Zero issues. |
| `python3 tool/check-docs.py` | Docs gate: page shape, relative links, fragments, ToC reachability. 0 issues. |
| `dart pub publish --dry-run` | Archive check; 0 warnings on a clean tree (the only expected one before a release is the missing CHANGELOG section for the new version). |

## Post-Change Checklist

A change is not done while any of these is stale: `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]`, `README.md`, `llms.txt`, the affected `doc/` page, `skills/dowel/` and `ARCHITECTURE.md`. Then run the format, analyze, test and docs commands above.

## Development Flow

Red, green, refactor: the failing test comes first, and reverting the implementation must turn it red again. Branch from `master` as `<type>/<topic>` (`feat`, `fix`, `chore`, `docs`, `refactor`, `test`, `release`) and open a PR into `master`.

## Testing

- Tests mirror the `lib/src/` layout (`lib/src/installer/plugin_installer.dart` is covered by `test/installer/plugin_installer_*_test.dart`).
- A test that spawns a real toolchain (`flutter create`, `dart pub get`) carries the `integration` tag (`dart_test.yaml`).

## Architecture

`bin/dowel.dart` is this package's own entry point, never a consumer wrapper: a consumer project's wrapper is `bin/dispatcher.dart`, rendered by `dowel install` from `assets/stubs/dispatcher.dart.stub`, and `defaultConsumerWrapperName` ignores `bin/dowel.dart` so `dowel` never delegates to itself.

Before changing module boundaries or a main flow, read ARCHITECTURE.md; update it in the same change when a boundary, flow or invariant moves.

## Key Gotchas

| Mistake | Fix |
|---|---|
| Editing `lib/app/_plugins.g.dart` or `lib/app/commands/_index.g.dart` (this repo's copies live in `example/`) | Generated; run `commands:refresh` or `plugins:refresh` |
| Running a command that uses the session (`reload`, `stop`, `tinker`, a plugin's `<package>:*`) in a git worktree before `dowel start` there | Run `dowel start` in the worktree first, or pass `--state=<path>`. `sessionOwnershipError` passes when the worktree sits inside the project root the main app recorded (an app at the repo root, the worktree under `.claude/worktrees/<slug>/`) and for state with no recorded `projectRoot`; the command then acts on the main app and reports success. A sibling checkout, or an app in a subdirectory the worktree is not inside (this repo's `example/`), is refused. MCP plugin tools and `dowel_tinker` run no check, and an MCP server falls back to the shared pointer when its own project has no session. `--state=<path>` skips the check, and a missing file falls back to the pointer too |
| Committing `.dowel/` | The suite writes install records into it in the repo root; it is gitignored, never force-add it |
| `path:` dependencies in docs or the archive | Docs use the caret form or `dart pub add`; `install` picks the dependency shape itself |
| Comparing the signature DSL to another framework's console, by name or as "X-style" or "X-inspired", in code, docs, comments, commits or README | Forbidden; describe the signature DSL on its own terms |
| An em or en dash in authored text | Comma, colon, semicolon, period or parentheses |
| Lifecycle commands on Windows | `start`, `stop`, `reload`, `hot-restart` use a POSIX FIFO; macOS and Linux only |

## Conventions

- Signature DSL first (`'cmd:name {arg} {--flag}'`); `configure(ArgParser)` only for what it cannot express. `final class` on every new public type.
- A new persistent write stages `<path>.tmp` and renames over the target, so open editors and lint daemons never see a partial file.
- MCP tool descriptions open with an imperative sentence and keep the critical information first; clients truncate at 2 KB.
- Numbered step comments for methods with three or more phases; `///` only on public API.

## Release

1. `release: X.Y.Z` PR: bump every stamp, promote `[Unreleased]` to `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD` with its footer compare link.
2. Stamps: `pubspec.yaml`; `dowelVersion` in `lib/src/console/dowel_version.dart`, the only version literal in code (`dowel_version_test.dart` and `mcp_server_version_test.dart` guard it); `example/pubspec.yaml` and `example/packages/awesome_plugin/pubspec.yaml` (`flutter pub get` fails when they drift); `server.json` (`server_json_version_test.dart` guards it; the MCP registry never rewrites a published version). The skill keeps its own `version:` in `skills/dowel/SKILL.md`. Docs that quote the caret constraint track the released version.
3. After it merges, tag the merge commit with the bare version: `git tag X.Y.Z && git push origin X.Y.Z`. `publish.yml` validates it (tag on `master`, `pubspec.yaml` and `server.json` carry the version, pana 160/160, a CHANGELOG section), publishes through OIDC and creates the GitHub Release.
4. A recovery after a failed `Validate` is forward: delete the tag, fix on a PR, tag the new merge commit.

## CI

`master` is protected; the required checks are `Lint & Test` (`ci.yml`), `Changelog` and `Internal Links`.

- `Changelog` (`changelog.yml`): a PR that changes `lib/`, `bin/` or `assets/` must change `CHANGELOG.md`; Dependabot, `release:` PRs and the `skip-changelog` label are exempt.
- `Internal Links` (`docs-link-check.yml`) runs the docs gate plus an offline lychee pass; `External Links` runs Mondays and is not required.
